items.title: PLASA Awards for Innovation 2026 winners announced
items.summary: PLASA has announced the winners of its 2026 Awards for Innovation, recognising new entertainment and stage lighting technologies for safety, efficiency and performance improvements.

items.title: Showlight comes to Spain in 2029
items.summary: Showlight, the quadrennial lighting design conference, will hold its 2029 edition in Granada, Spain, sponsored by manufacturers Ayrton and SGM.

items.title: Measuring Good Design
items.summary: An industry perspective piece asks how illuminated architecture's value and quality can be assessed, raising the question of metrics for evaluating good lighting design beyond subjective judgement.
